objective: 常态化批次A(任务书3.12): fob_demands_2026.json(gz入仓) 去重+品类分布统计。产出: 统计台账 + 清洗后文件(artifact result_clean.json)

shards.expected_output: 去重前后行数/重复模式/板块·需求类型·能力分布 JSON

shards.instructions: python3 -c 'import json,gzip;d=json.loads(gzip.decompress(open("tasks/payloads/fob_demands_2026.json.gz","rb").read()).decode("utf-8"));ps=d["posts"];seen=set();u=[p for p in ps if (p.get("thread_id") not in seen and not seen.add(p.get("thread_id")))];json.dump({"posts":u},open("result_clean.json","w"),ensure_ascii=False);print("rows_raw=%d unique=%d removed=%d"%(len(ps),len(u),len(ps)-len(u)))'
shards.expected_output: result_clean.json 写入工作区(经artifact回收)+行数摘要
